title: I am looking for experienced users of the Cornix platform to test my bot
author: profittoinvest
selftext: Hi everyone. I have a bot running on the Cornix platform, and I’d like to list it on their Marketplace because it’s delivering excellent results—it’s polished enough to compete with the top groups. However, I’d like to get feedback from experienced users who have a spare slot and can connect to my bot. As you know, the bot can also be tested on a demo account, allowing you to compare its performance against the bots you currently use. I’m looking for a maximum of about 5 people. The exchanges the bot supports properly are BingX and Bitget; currently, only these two correctly execute signals in hedge mode. The bot operates based on a portfolio it builds itself, rather than just relying on individual signals. It can generate opposing signals on the same currency pairs (up to 4 signals per pair). I’m not sure how it would behave on other exchanges, but KuCoin, Bybit, and Binance are definitely out of the question. I’d appreciate your feedback; in return for your help—which is really important to me—you’ll get free, lifetime access to the bot. I have to admit, I thought the Cornix platform was more popular, but it’s actually hard to find anyone here :) Best regards.
